docs.title: Panels and additionals Gizmos which comes with addon
Color operators
docs.text:
Select strokes and change its color using different operators.

After executing operator you will find its options (working live) in the Adjust Last Operation panel in the left bottom corner of 3d View.

docs.title: Apply
docs.text: Applies current brush color onto selected strokes. If you Apply color without any key pressed it applies to fills and outlines If you want to apply color to fills only use CONTROL key modifier. If you want to apply color to outlines only use SHIFT key modifier.

docs.title: Create New Palette popup window
docs.text:
You can create: - new empty palette - palette based on visible grease pencil image - import any palette from other .blend file

Example of palettes generated by Create New Palette -> Current Grease Pencil:

docs.title: Show Swatches toggle button
docs.text:
With this button you can switch on/off palette swatches in 3d View

Use this swatches to change current brush color when in Paint mode or to fast change selected stroke colors when in Edit mode (with CONTROL key it changes fills, with SHIFT key it changes outlines).

docs.title: Arrange
docs.text: Arrange strokes in classic way, to change their order (works only in 2D Layers mode)

docs.title: Stroke operators
docs.text: Additional stroke operators, in Edit mode they works on selected strokes, in other modes works on last drawn stroke (it makes life easier when you want to change last drawn stroke without going into Edit mode)

docs.title: Separate
docs.text: Separates strokes into new Grease Pencil object. Works better than default Separate operator.

docs.title: Resample
docs.text: Makes Simplify and Smooth operator on stroke to make it more regular, with option to close stroke. This prepres stroke for better sculpting.

docs.title: Transform
docs.text: Toggles classic 2D transform gizmos drawn around selection

docs.title: Operation
docs.text: Toggles Operation gizmos (Duplicate, Flip Horizontal, Flop Vertical, Delete buttons)

docs.title: Strokes
docs.text: Toggles native strokes viibility in Edit and Sculpt mode
